entry.title: New: Resolution 300 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO WAIMEA HAWAIIAN HOMESTEADERS’ ASSOCIATION, INC., TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE 73RD ANNUAL PANIOLO PARADE

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
